name: Energy Manipulation
description: Energy Manipulation allows you to channel energy to deliver deadly blows. These powers also help you focus your power to increase your own abilities.

powers.name: Power Thrust
powers.description:
A focused attack that violently shoves the target and sends them flying. Deals minimal damage, but can be very effective.

Damage: Minor.
Recharge: Fast.

powers.name: Energy Punch
powers.description:
Powerful focused punch that may Disorient your opponent!

Damage: High.
Recharge: Moderate.

powers.name: Build Up
powers.description:
Greatly increases the amount of damage you deal for a few seconds, as well as slightly increasing your chance to hit.

Recharge: Long.

powers.name: Bone Smasher
powers.description:
The Bone Smasher is a slow attack, but makes up for it with a good amount of damage. Has a greater chance to Disorient than Energy Punch.

Damage: Superior.
Recharge: Slow.

powers.name: Energize
powers.description:
You can channel a tremendous amount of energy through your body for a short period of time. Doing so will heal some hit points, reduce the endurance cost of your powers, boost your regeneration dramatically, and make you resistant to Stuns for a short time.

Recharge: Long.

powers.name: Stun
powers.description:
Stun deals a little bit of damage, but Disorients its target a great deal. This attack can Disorient most opponents. If this power is used under the effects of Boost Range, this power will become a ranged stun instead. If this power is used under the effect of Power Boost, it will become an AoE stun, but it will recharge in 90 seconds instead of 12. Both these effects can be combined for the power to become a ranged AoE stun.

Damage: Minor.
Recharge: Slow.
powers.shortHelp: Melee, Minor DMG(Energy/Smashing), Foe Disorient, Special

formVariants.description:

Notes: Stun (Extended+Expanded) is unaffected by Range changes.

Damage: Minor.
Recharge: Long.

Notes: Stun (Extended) is unaffected by Range changes.

Damage: Minor.
Recharge: Slow.

Damage: Minor.
Recharge: Long.

powers.name: Power Boost
powers.description:
Greatly boosts the secondary effects of your powers. Your powers effects like Heals, Defense Buffs, Endurance Drains, Disorients, Holds, Immobilizes, Knockbacks and more, are all improved. The effects of Power Boost last a short while, and only the next couple of attacks will be boosted.

Recharge: Slow.

powers.name: Boost Range
powers.description:
You can boost your powers to increase the range of your next few attacks.

Recharge: Slow.

powers.name: Total Focus
powers.description:
Total Focus is complete mastery over Energy Melee. This is a very slow, but incredibly devastating attack that can knock out most opponents, leaving them Disoriented. Due to the exhausting nature of Total Focus, recharge time is very long.

Damage: Extreme.
Recharge: Slow.
